rendering.id_and_projectId: assigned or resolved during vendor deployment; store actual spec ID in tool_registry
rendering.schema: resolve tool input/output $refs and placeholders before vendor import
rendering.model: resolve through verified runtime snapshot and active model catalog
rendering.secrets: ephemeral runtime credential delivery; never persist in generated spec
rendering.error_mapping: vendor transport/AI failures map to common response errors; a successful HTTP response alone is not tool success

mcp.name_mapping: replace each dot with underscore; verify uniqueness before deployment
mcp.inputSchema: compiled tool.inputSchema only; trusted context injected server-side
mcp.outputSchema: compiled common response envelope narrowed to tool.outputSchema on success
mcp.routing: MCP -> CallCraft -> scoped internal backend endpoint
mcp.discovery: only active registry tools intersected with verified purpose, scopes and resource policy
mcp.failure: map domain failed status to MCP error semantics supported by deployed SDK; preserve structured error
activation_gates: service auth and execution context propagation

unverified_vendor_capabilities: The supplied export describes AI extraction tools, but does not demonstrate HTTP backend binding.
Do not invent vendor endpoint/auth/binding fields; capture a real redacted export and execution fixture in Phase 0.
Do not forward execution tokens through prompts or LLM-visible arguments.
